title: 黑默丁格·高塔发明家
description: 大发明家保持金色蓬发与白胡须，在高塔露台稳稳站立，护目镜和完整工装受侧光映照，装置静置脚边。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Heimerdinger is a small adult yordle inventor with an enormous golden hair mass, broad white moustache, round goggles, compact limbs, and a blue scientist's coat. Preserve his canonical yordle proportions without making the head even larger or adding infant features. Fully covering work clothes and boots conceal his body, while a compact turret-like invention remains inactive beside a closed equipment case.
art_direction.scene: He stands upright on a broad secure observatory terrace, hands loosely behind his back as he surveys distant geometric city towers. The inactive invention stays grounded and pointed away from the view. Hard afternoon light separates golden hair and blue coat into coarse wax-crayon facets; a huge empty circular doorway behind him conveys scale without clutter, gadgets in motion, or lettering.
art_direction.palette: golden hair, blue coat, white moustache, brass light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
